call_points.text: Order inflow guidance of ₹1,600 Cr for FY27, excluding the Uttam order.
EBITDA margins expected similar to last year with a positive delta; no specific band committed.
Interest cost fell in Q1 because positive cash at FY26-end meant minimal overdraft use.
Management said it will not dilute equity for working capital, citing positive operating cash flow.
Q1 revenue slipped on inspection issues, specification proof and supply chain delays; management expects catch-up in Q3 and Q4.
Working capital is expected to stay similar to last year, with pressure building in Q3 and Q4.
S.G. Reddy is stepping down as Managing Director, handing over to M.V. Reddy and Atim Kabra.
FY27 revenue guided at ₹1,300-1,400 Cr, 15-20% growth over FY26, split 40% R&D and 60% production.
Management said current margins are the top end and investors should factor in slightly lower numbers.
Q4 FY26 fresh orders were about ₹530 Cr, including SDR programs, BEL radar subsystems and Gaganyaan checkout hardware from ISRO.
Uttam radar negotiations with HAL are near final; order expected in Q2 or Q3 FY27.
QRSAM orders expected three to four months after BEL receives its main contract; small first-production-model orders already received.
Export gross margin is around 45%, against single digits in the old build-to-print business.
FY26 operating cash flow was ₹370 Cr versus minus ₹99 Cr last year; finance cost expected similar.
Board has in-principle approved a demerger of the space, meteorology and hydrology business; detailed scheme expected in the next few weeks.

operating_notes.text: Order book was ₹2,141 Cr standalone and ₹2,600 Cr consolidated as on 31 March 2026, with about ₹530 Cr of fresh orders in Q4 FY26.
Management sees visibility of approximately ₹1,600 Cr plus orders bookable in FY27, about 25% from R&D programs.
JV Astra Rafael Comsys closed FY26 with an order book of about ₹625 Cr and is expected to deliver over ₹600 Cr revenue in FY27.
Standalone order book at Q1FY27 end was ₹2,156 Cr, about 66% defence and 34% space, metrology and hydrology.
Astra Rafael Comsys had an order book of ₹836 Cr and plans ₹360 Cr of sales in the current year.
Space sector is expected to contribute about ₹120-150 Cr of the ₹1,350 Cr FY27 revenue guidance.
